text:
sec-bot: ALERT: IdP signing certificate (Okta) for corporate SSO will expire in 10 days (2026-04-02 00:00 UTC). High impact: 24 internal service providers + 5 external partners currently validate against this cert. Full report: https://redwood.internal/sec/alerts/1934567890

marta: Wow — thanks for the ping. Which internal apps? any customer-facing ones?

sec-bot: Breakdown (summary): 24 internal SPs across eng, infra, and platform namespaces. External partners: analytics-partner, payroll-gateway, partner-api-1, monitoring-external, vendor-idp. No public-facing product auth endpoints are on the list, but payroll & partner-api-1 are customer-adjacent. Details in the report.

kevin: Platform here. We rotate the IdP cert via the Okta console + upload new cert to our SAML SP configs. Is there an automated flow to update SP metadata?

leo: We have two automation paths: 1) For apps deployed via infra-managed config repo: update saml/metadata.yaml and run infra pipeline which posts new metadata to each SP. 2) For apps with manual config (legacy), ops/product teams must manually upload the new IdP cert to their SP settings.

kevin: Can we share a checklist and a small script for the infra-managed path? saves time.

sec-pm: Opening org ticket SEC-2026-048 to track rotation. Owners must claim their app within 48 hours in the ticket or in this thread. If unclaimed, security will coordinate a scheduled update in the maintenance window and notify app owners.

marta: I own several internal dashboards. I'll claim them in SEC-2026-048 now and coordinate times.

leo: Checklist (quick):
1) Generate new signing cert in Okta (RSA-2048) or upload CSR if using external CA.
2) Export IdP metadata XML or cert blob.
3) For infra-managed apps: bump saml/metadata.yaml -> PR -> infra pipeline will push new metadata.
4) For manual apps: upload cert in SP admin and run smoke tests.
5) Coordinate partner rotations (we'll need partner contact + maintenance window).

leo: Example curl to fetch updated metadata for an SP after rotation:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  https://infra.redwood.internal/api/v1/saml/metadata/my-app | xmllint --format -
```

kevin: Important: Add a pre-rotation smoke test: assert AssertionConsumerService (ACS) URL responds, and a login SAML assertion completes for a test user. If smoke fails, rollback metadata.

ops-oncall: Ops can reserve a maintenance window tonight between 02:00-04:00 UTC if teams prefer out-of-hours. Please indicate which apps need the window.

sec-pm: Policy note: After this rotation we will update the SSO playbook to require automated CI-managed metadata for all new SPs and a 60-day cert validity maximum. Existing manual apps will have 6 months to migrate.

marta: For partner-api-1, I've reached out to their integration lead and proposed Wed 03:00 UTC. Will confirm.

kevin: We should also add monitoring: post-rotation we will enable a synthetic login every 15m for 48h to watch for failures. Can SRE help run the synthetic checks?

leo: SRE can run the check once we provide test credentials and ACS endpoints. We'll coordinate in SEC-2026-048.

sec-bot: Automated action suggestion: If owner does not claim within 48h, schedule automatic metadata update during next maintenance window. Impacting apps will receive a 48h pre-notice email and will be temporarily disabled if integration fails after rotation.

sec-pm: Owners: claim now in SEC-2026-048 and update the owner field in the identity registry: https://redwood.internal/identity/apps. Also paste any partner contact emails into the ticket.

ops-oncall: Noted. If you book the 02:00-04:00 UTC window, @ops-oncall will be on-call and reachable by phone. Add runbook link to your ticket.

marta: Claimed: internal-dash-1, internal-dash-2. I'll add partner contact for payroll-gateway.

kevin: Claimed: infra-auth-proxy, auth-token-service. We'll use infra pipeline and aim for Friday night window.

leo: We'll run a dry-run for infra-managed apps in a staging cluster first. If staging smoke passes, production push scheduled as agreed.

sec-pm: Reminder: after rotation, update audit ticket with evidence (screenshot of new cert in Okta, PR links, smoke test logs). Security will review and close SEC-2026-048.

sec-bot: Reminder set: 48h claim deadline = 1934663290 (approx). Automated notices to unclaimed owners will be sent at 1934630000.

kevin: Thanks. We'll coordinate PRs and tag @ops-oncall for the maintenance window.

marta: Thanks team — starting partner outreach now.

sec-pm: Thanks everyone. If any app reports login failures after rotation, file in #incidents and tag @sec-pm and @ops-oncall immediately. :rotating_light:
